New Zealand v India. Coverage of the third day of the Second and Final Test in the series from Hagley Oval in Christchurch. The hosts will be looking to extend their impressive recent record against India in this format having won four of the last six Test series against their visitors. New Zealand will also be aiming to extend their unbeaten home record against their visitors to three series, having not lost a Test series to India since a 1-0 defeat in 2009.

Australia v England. Coverage of the fourth T20 in the five-match series from Sydney Cricket Ground. The hosts will be looking to improve a record that has seen them win just two of their last 11 matches in a T20 series against England before the start of this tour. Since Australia's last series victory over England back in 2014, the visitors have won two of the last three series, picking up five wins in seven completed T20's.

Everton v Liverpool (Kick-off 12.00pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Hill Dickinson Stadium. The visitors have a strong recent record against their city rivals and have only lost one of their last 10 games against the Toffees. The Reds have also won the last three encounters against their hosts, including doing the double over Everton last season. This meeting last year saw Virgil van Dijk score the winner in stoppage time to give Liverpool a 2-1 win in their first visit to the Hill Dickinson Stadium.

A 2-1 victory for Cagliari alongside a 4-1 win for Como against Cremonese saw the visitors miss out on a place in Europe's premier competition for the second season running.

The last three winners of this event have all been English with Ronnie O'Sullivan, Judd Trump and Mark Selby all coming out on top since 2023.
